## Episode Thesis

This episode is a CEO interview with Katarina Gabrielsson of Oriola, a Nordic pharmaceutical distributor listed in Helsinki. She walks through the company's updated strategy to 2029: profitable growth, efficiency and partnerships. The targets include a cost-to-revenue ratio below 75% and a '10-10-10' plan to double EBITDA, supported by a new ERP system and new automated logistics centres in Finland and Sweden. The tone is steady and cautiously positive. Q1 beat the prior year and Q2 was roughly flat because of freight and fuel costs. Kronans Apotek, which Oriola owns half of, has improved after its integration, and a decision on its future is due within two years.
